extracted.intended_audience: corporate public relations teams, crisis-communications professionals, and company executives responsible for managing product-safety crises
extracted.subtask_description: Actionable guidance for a corporation responding to a high-profile product safety crisis (exploding phones/recall), covering media strategy, customer remedies, investor communications, and internal preparedness. Focuses on immediate steps and remediation to limit reputational and market damage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate crisis management / rapid response
rubrics_metrics.description: Samsung is in need of immediate crisis management as the damage from the Galaxy Note 7 and its burning battery escalates. The company’s lack of crisis communications in the two weeks the crisis has unfolded is an epic failure and demonstrates why companies need a crisis management plan in place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act rapidly — delays are costly and fatal. The piece criticizes Samsung’s lack of response during the initial stages and frames immediate, decisive action as the first priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a clear, detailed public explanation of the issue
rubrics_metrics.description: It needs to clearly address the issue of what is happening. One of the major complaints of many consumers is the company is providing very little information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain in detail what the problem is so consumers understand the defect and the risks involved; avoid vague statements that increase consumer frustration and distrust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deploy visible spokespersons to media, especially television
rubrics_metrics.description: They need to have its spokespersons in front of the media especially on television explaining in detail what the problem is.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use senior, credible spokespeople on high-reach platforms to communicate details, reassure the public, and demonstrate accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reassure public that other products are not affected
rubrics_metrics.description: They need to reassure the public that other Samsung smartphones will not be affected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state which models are safe and back claims with evidence to avoid contagion effects across the product line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue a sincere apology to consumers
rubrics_metrics.description: The company also needs to apologize to consumers...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apologize publicly and clearly; apologies should acknowledge harm and express commitment to fix the problem, not be perfunctory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spell out corrective actions and consumer remedies in detail
rubrics_metrics.description: …spell out in detail what it is doing to correct the problem and what the company is providing consumers in compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concrete, detailed plan of remediation steps (replacement programs, repairs, timelines) and specific remedies so consumers know exactly what to expect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer meaningful compensation (avoid token amounts)
rubrics_metrics.description: They need to offer more than just a $25 gift card or bill credit. Offering a $100 gift card or bill credit or even more is called for considering the gravity of the situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compensation should be proportional to severity and consumer risk; low-value gestures may inflame public sentiment. The author suggests significantly larger credits or refunds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure replacement/exchange process is smooth, consistent, and clearly communicated
rubrics_metrics.description: Samsung had already announced a replacement program... Yet consumers are complaining that the process is anything but smooth and they are receiving conflicting reports from the company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design and execute exchange/recall logistics so customers receive consistent information and a frictionless experience; conflicting internal messages are damaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run a coordinated media campaign, including full‑page apology ads
rubrics_metrics.description: Along with a coordinated media campaign, Samsung should place full page ads in newspapers around the nation apologizing, explaining what it is doing to correct the issue, and reassure consumers on the soundness of its products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine earned and paid media to reach broad audiences; use prominent ads to apologize, explain corrective actions, and rebuild trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use pricing/promotional tactics to stem market share loss
rubrics_metrics.description: It should announce a deep discount of its other smartphones. At this point with Apple releasing the iPhone 7 and confidence in Samsung rapidly declining, a price reduction of its other phones is critical to prevent further market erosion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider temporary price cuts or promotions for non-affected products to retain customers and limit defections to competitors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announce an independent investigation into cause and communications failures
rubrics_metrics.description: Announce that company is conducting an investigation to find out what happened, and also why there were mis-communications with consumers. The investigation should be headed by someone outside of the company who is respected by both consumers and investors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commission an external, credible investigator to restore confidence; investigate both technical root causes and communications breakdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactively communicate with investors about viability and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate to investors and reassure them of the company’s viability in the smartphone market and let them know where the company is headed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brief investors with transparent, forward-looking plans to reduce market panic and explain business continuity and recovery strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with regulators and acknowledge official recalls/safety orders
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Galaxy Note 7 smartphones... The Consumer Product Safety Commission has announced a recall of the device. The U.S. Department of Transportation has had the Federal Aviation Administration order airline passengers not to bring Samsung Galaxy Note 7 phones on planes unless they keep them turned off and don't charge them during the flight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge and cooperate with regulatory actions and public-safety guidance; incorporate regulator instructions into public messaging and consumer remediation steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain readiness: have a crisis-communication plan before a crisis
rubrics_metrics.description: For any company watching this crisis, this should serve as a notice for the need to have a crisis communication in plan before a crisis hits as delay is costly and fatal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and test crisis plans in advance (spokespeople, messaging playbooks, operational logistics) so the organization can respond quickly when incidents occur.
